name: ai-daily-cn-static-publisher
description: Local static publishing infrastructure for Chinese AI daily reports.

scripts.status:self-check: node src/cli.js status:self-check --data-input reports-data --input reports-source --out docs
scripts.build: node src/cli.js build --data-input reports-data --input reports-source --out docs
scripts.test: node --test tests/unit.test.js tests/publish.test.js tests/skills.test.js tests/story-authoring.test.js tests/generation-first.test.js tests/content-contract.test.js tests/page-check-tiering.test.js tests/source-coverage.test.js tests/trends.test.js tests/article-index.test.js tests/official-blog-knowledge.test.js tests/daily-codex-pipeline.test.js tests/daily-codex-dag.test.js tests/source-watch.test.js
scripts.validate:docs: pnpm run harness:init && pnpm run harness:validate && pnpm run retrospectives:validate && pnpm run sources:display-contract && pnpm run privacy:validate && git diff --check
scripts.validate: pnpm run harness:init && pnpm run harness:validate && pnpm run retrospectives:validate && pnpm run content:contract && pnpm run content:contract:self-test && pnpm run feedback:validate && pnpm run dag:validate && pnpm run workflow:validate && pnpm run resilience:validate && pnpm run source-reset:preflight && pnpm run sources:validate && pnpm run sources:display-contract && pnpm run test && pnpm run build:check-clean && pnpm run privacy:validate && pnpm run test:e2e && git diff --check
scripts.publish:dry-run: node src/cli.js publish:dry-run --data-input reports-data --input reports-source --out docs
scripts.publish:dry-run:daily: node src/cli.js publish:dry-run:daily --data-input reports-data --input reports-source --out docs
